source_review.notes: Checked RFC 9110 field parsing, limits, content, and request semantics; RFC 8259 JSON grammar, Unicode, number, duplicate-name, and parser-limit guidance; OpenAPI 3.2.0 request/parameter serialization and data-conversion rules; JSON Schema 2020-12 Core and Validation; and RFC 9457.

evidence: Reviewed partial framing/decoding/parsing/validation/mapping functions, accepted-domain composition, and normalization idempotence notation.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Every symbol and stage is defined, and TeX remains within GitHub-supported delimiters.

evidence: Executed five pipeline cases and verified unsupported media, malformed JSON, wrong quantity type, nonpositive quantity, and accepted input reach the declared first failure stage.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Outputs match exact expectations and no later stage overrides an earlier rejection.

evidence: Checked composition order, partial-function domains, one-way lossy conversions, normalization idempotence, and first-failure ownership.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The accepted-set equation is scoped to the modeled pipeline and does not imply authorization.

evidence: Reviewed framing disagreement, field and decompression limits, invalid UTF-8, duplicate names, deep nesting, huge numbers, double decoding, repeated parameters, hidden coercion, union/schema behavior, regex cost, disclosure, and parser upgrades.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Byte, framing, decoding, syntax, structure, semantic, state, authorization, and resource boundaries remain distinct.

evidence: Checked early bounded work, one canonical interpretation, strict media selection, location-specific parsing, duplicate rejection, no hidden coercion, exact schema dialect, owned validation layers, safe bounded errors, and no effects after rejection.
invariant_checking.notes: Gateway and service responsibilities are compared without treating either as universal proof.

proof_review.notes: No theorem or exhaustive proof over all bytes and runtimes is claimed.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No proof sketch is claimed; pipeline equations define obligations and scope.

evidence: The executable classifier explicitly disclaims HTTP and JSON parsing and domain sufficiency; unit, contract, differential, fuzz, integration, and deployment evidence are separately bounded.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No local parser example is presented as production safety or universal conformance.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed whole-request framing, early limits, stage separation, media selection, parameter locations, strict JSON, coercion, schema/dialect, semantic layering, authorization, normalization, errors, algorithmic abuse, explicit pipeline, and deployed-layer verification.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed proxy/origin differentials, decompression bombs, multipart limits, exact decoding, duplicate members, number precision, binder behavior, remote references, error disclosure, cost budgets, upgrade pinning, telemetry, and absence of effects.

pedagogical_review.notes: Reviewed one-page retrieval, explicit stage taxonomy, one executable precedence audit, ten distinct worked examples, and five exercises progressing from classification through trace, implementation, design comparison, and differential transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
